title: First-Class Appendices for Print Reports and Zwischenbericht Anhänge
description: Add first-class appendix support to the semio print system (print/tex/): an appendix is a document attached to the main report, behaving like a chapter — numbered A, B, C…, labeled Anhang/Appendix, TOC entry, chip styling, cross-referenceable via \appendixref, listed via \listofappendices. Fix a pre-existing bug where window registers (\listoffigures etc.) render header-only because semio@render@register reads the wrong body macro. Wire the feature into all six print templates (report, paper, flyer n/a, zukunftbau forschungsbericht/zwischenbericht/kompaktbericht). Then apply it to mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex: convert 9 Anhang markdown documents from temp/ into 8 LaTeX appendices (A-H), including a 67-project table with per-row avatar images sourced from temp/projekt_bilder/ (downscaled ~600px, copied into zwischenbericht/asset/projekt/). Update body cross-references to use \appendixref. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/print-reports-should-be-joyful-haven.md.
summary:
Fixed a rendering bug reported by the user: composed hierarchy identifiers like "BB-M" rendered fully in one uniform color instead of muting the parent segment ("BB-") and highlighting only the final one ("M"). The existing muting logic (`\semio_hierarchy_chip_number:n` for in-body window/heading chips, `\semio_toc_number:n` for the main table of contents, both in semio-core.sty) only recognized "." as a hierarchy separator, a holdover from before appendices could compose identifiers with "-" (e.g. `BB-M`, `I-DG`, `SB-B`). Anything without a "." — every appendix-chapter identifier — rendered as one unmuted block.

Replaced both functions' bodies with a shared `\semio_identifier_split_point:n` helper that finds the *last* occurrence of either "-" or "." (via a throwaway copy normalized to "." only, then a plain dot-split to locate the character offset) and slices the muted head / bright tail back out of the original string by character range (`\tl_range:Nnn`), so whichever separator actually introduced the final segment is preserved in the muted portion. Also fixed `\SemioTableRegisterRow` (semio-table.sty), used by `\listofappendices`/`\listoffigures`/`\listoftables`/etc., which printed its identifier column as raw unstyled text with no muting at all — now routed through the same `\semio@toc@number` bridge the main TOC rows already use, for visual consistency between the two "Nr. Titel Seite"-style tables.

Verified via an isolated expl3 prototype (BB-M → "BB-"+"M", SB-B.1 → "SB-B."+"1", I-DG.3 → "I-DG."+"3", H → ""+"H", US-SA → "US-"+"SA" — all correct) before touching the real macros, then rebuilt all 6 print templates and the full zwischenbericht and visually confirmed via cropped page renders at 250-300dpi: the main TOC ("BB-" muted / "M" bold, "US-S.1.0." muted / final digit bold at even deeper nesting), the appendix register, and live in-body window chips ("Tabelle: I-T.a" → "I-T." muted / "a" bold) all now mute correctly regardless of which separator composes the identifier. Zero compile errors across both builds.
